scene: The telescope reveals grand transit hubs beyond Spice Bridge.
picture: Flat side view. Along a high transit junction, the player in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre. At the far left, a yellow cable tram waits beside its steel cable. In the centre sits an open green glass-roofed trolley. On the far right stands a brass spiral lift cage with open gate.
shown: a bright yellow mountain cable tram parked waiting at a wooden dock at the far left
a green glass-roofed trolley idling on tracks with doors open in the centre
a polished brass spiral lift cage resting at its platform on the far right

variants.scene: Salty harbour air stirs as evening transit cars prepare to depart the boardwalk.
Lanterns glow warmly over the busy wooden platform high above the harbour.
You hum {tune} as travelers bustle along the airy wooden deck.
